questions.prompt: Which command lists all storage pools configured in your Juju environment?
questions.explanation: 'juju storage-pools' displays all available storage backend pools.

questions.prompt: How do you specify persistent storage constraints (such as size) when deploying a charm?
questions.explanation: The '--storage' parameter binds charm storage tags to storage pool definitions and sizes.

questions.prompt: Which command inspects all active volumes and filesystems provisioned in the current model?
questions.explanation: 'juju storage' lists storage instances, attachments, and status.
